messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — field is asking for an 'AWS routing parity' capability to match competitor X. Sales says it's becoming a gating item for a few mid-market deals. Can we decide: full parity work (weeks) vs a minimal compatibility shim (days/weeks)?
Raj (Sales): +1 from several accounts. They need the same routing controls exposed in UI & API. If we don’t show something soon we risk losing 2 pilots.
Matt (Eng): Doable as a shim but we need to be explicit about tradeoffs: no KV cache sharing, will route to a compatible model variant and fall back to a slower code path. Estimated 2–3 sprint effort for a safe shim with tests. Full parity is 6+ sprints.
Claire (Design): If we go shim, UX needs a clear label: "Compatibility mode (limited features)" so customers and support know the limitations. We should avoid surfacing it as our default.
Jules (SRE): Operational concerns: parity-style routing increases cross-tenant routing complexity. Live rollout should start with a single pilot tenant and a 0%->100% FF ramp. Need canary & alerting hooks.
Anya (PM): Proposed decision: ship a minimal compatibility shim behind a feature-flag, with these launch criteria:
- API parity surface: endpoints + params accepted (but some params will be no-ops)
- UX label + gating copy from Claire
- Perf regression <= 5% on P99 latency vs normal route (Jules to validate)
- Canary with 1 pilot tenant for 2 weeks
- Docs + migration notes for Sales (Raj)
If this passes, we keep full-parity on roadmap but deprioritize by 3 quarters. Thoughts?
Matt (Eng): I can break into three PRs: api-compat, routing-fallback, ff-guard. Timeline: api-compat + ff-guard in 2 weeks, routing-fallback in next sprint. Need a small infra spike for routing rules.
Claire (Design): I'll draft the label copy and a small in-app banner for the pilot. Can share mockups by EOD Friday.
Raj (Sales): Great. I’ll line up the pilot tenant (ACME Systems) and prepare migration notes. Can we have an FAQ doc snippet for "what's missing in compatibility mode"?
Jules (SRE): I'll add canary alerts: error-rate, latency delta, and routing-incorrect-rate. Also adding a rollback playbook.
ProductBot: New doc created: https://redwood.docs/internal/product/compat-shim (internal) — owners: Anya, Matt, Claire, Jules, Raj.
Anya (PM): OK — action items: Matt + Jules pair on infra spike, Claire on copy, Raj on pilot comms. I'll update the roadmap: move full parity to Q4 and mark shim as "ship candidate" for next minor. :thumbsup:
Matt (Eng): Sounds good. Will post a short RFC in #eng-runtime with PR plan.
Raj (Sales): Thanks — I'll brief the AE for the pilot tomorrow. :rocket:
Claire (Design): Mockups posted. Feedback welcome. :eyes:
Jules (SRE): Canary config (example):
```yaml
feature_flag: compat_shim
rollout: 0->5->25->100
canary_tenant: acme-systems
metrics: [p99_latency, error_rate, routing_mismatch_rate]
```
Anya (PM): Closing the loop — if canary fails, rollback to off and we escalate to oncall. If canary passes, we schedule docs + public announcement for GA. Thanks everyone.
